the value appears in a run of two or more adjacent equal elements (as Unix uniq treats duplicates)

phrase: remove all elements that occur more than once
text: remove only the extra (repeated) occurrences of each value that occurs more than once, so exactly one occurrence of it remains in the result (remove_duplicates([1, 2, 3, 2, 4]) == [1, 2, 3, 4]); this agrees with the example R-EX-1 and the function name remove_duplicates
the example is authoritative: one occurrence (the first) of the repeated value 2 is kept, so R-RM-1 means removing only the extra copies
